relTest.notes: Faster camera: every photo is saved the moment you take it; stamping waits while you shoot and catches up in the pauses or while the phone charges (Settings → Saving and storage → When to stamp photos, or long-press ⏳ on the camera). Album thumbnails show the photo itself, ⏳ until stamped. Album by area shows photos without a category under Areas and lets you put them in a category. Report Captions: drawing tools open with the full-screen photo and save by themselves; the caption library is in Library → Notes/Captions. Storage warning before the phone fills up.
